title.en: Fable 13 — The Frog and the Ox

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: צפרדע ישבה על יד המים עם הילדים שלה.
sentences.en: A frog sat beside the water with her children.
A big ox came to drink from the river.
The little frogs ran away fast.

sentences.ar: הן חזרו אחר כך וסיפרו לאמא.
sentences.en: They came back afterwards and told their mother.

sentences.ar: הן אמרו: ראינו חיה גדולה מאוד.
sentences.en: They said: we saw a very big animal.
The mother said: big how much?
She breathed deep and became big.

sentences.ar: היא שאלה: היא הייתה גדולה ככה?
sentences.en: She asked: was it as big as this?

sentences.ar: הן אמרו: לא, הרבה יותר גדולה.
היא נשמה עוד פעם, חזק יותר.

sentences.en: She asked: and now? Now like it?

sentences.ar: הן אמרו: לא, את עוד קטנה.
sentences.en: They said: no, you are still small.
She did not listen to them at all.

sentences.ar: היא נשמה עוד פעם, הכי חזק.
ואז נשמע קול קטן, והיא נפלה.
sentences.en: And then a small sound was heard, and she fell.
The children sat beside her quietly.
Whoever wants to be someone else breaks.
